name: Maximum Projected Teaching-Set Size of Blockwise-Addressing
details: For the finite Blockwise-Addressing family; the lower endpoint is attained when $d=2$, and no general equality claim is made.
proof: The maximum projected teaching-set size equals the star number by Lemma~\ref{lem:star-projected-teaching}.  Substitute the established Blockwise-Addressing star-number interval $2^d\leq\mathrm S\leq2^{d+1}-1$.
